enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up face towel. Wet towel. Wipe face. Rinse towel. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Remove toast. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating care records
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's chart. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Ask patient questions. Record answers. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Check monitor. Write notes in care record. Use computer to update records. Walk to next patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's chart. Measure blood pressure.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Pick up tray. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Use restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, patient monitoring and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient's vital signs. Adjust oxygen mask. Administer medication. Update care record. Use computer to enter notes. Walk to nurse's station. Discuss patient status with colleague. Say 'Patient in room 3 needs monitoring.' Write handover notes. Prepare patient files. Walk to next patient room. Check IV drip. Measure blood pressure. Record observations. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves. Return to ward. Check patient monitor. Write final notes.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Step inside. Close door. Lock door. Remove shoes. Put down bag. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Apply soap. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out clothes. Put on clothes. Return towel to bathroom. Hang towel. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Cook chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes from table. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Put away leftover food. Close refrigerator. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to living room. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Put phone down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Pick up face wash. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
